    Functional Biomass (Functional Pool). Functional biomass is the algal biomass excluding carbohydrates and neutral lipids. The partitioning of the fixed carbon between the functional pool and the storage pool is regulated by the nitrogen cell quota $ Q_n $. We modeled the carbon fixation to the functional biomass ( $ R_1 $) in eq (1) based on the Droop model. $ ^{23} $ For simplicity, we modeled the degradation of functional biomass ( $ R_2 $) that contributes to respiration as a first-order relationship. The composition of functional biomass is assumed as $ CH_{1.8}O_{0.5}N_{0.2} $.

Symbols:
  A: Light absorbance per unit length [m^{-1}] (computed)
  a: Optical cross section of Chl-a [m^2 mol^{-1} X_{chl-C}] (parameter)
  X_{chl}: Concentration of Chl-a as C [mol X_{chl}-C m^{-3}] (computed)
  b: Optical cross section of biomass except Chl-a content [m^2 mol^{-1} C] (parameter)
  X_{C}: Total biomass carbon concentration [mol C m^{-3}] (variable)
  I_{avg}: Average light intensity inside the reactor, averaged over the optical path [mol photons m^{-2} d^{-1}] (computed)
  z_{t}: Thickness of the photobioreactor along the optical path [m] (parameter)
  d: Distance from the light source to the front of the reactor [m] (parameter)
  I_{avg_R}: Average reference light intensity over the optical path without attenuation by biomass [mol photons m^{-2} d^{-1}] (computed)
  P: Photosynthesis rate normalized to functional biomass [mol C (mol X_{cd}-C)^{-1} d^{-1}] (computed)
  X_{cd}: Concentration of functional biomass (algal biomass excluding carbohydrates and neutral lipids) as C [mol X_{cd}-C m^{-3}] (computed)
  P_{m}: Maximum rate coefficient in the carbon fixation law [time^{-1}] (parameter)
  I_{sat}: Light intensity at saturation in the carbon fixation law (computed)
  Y_{E}^{c}: Carbon yield on light energy adjusted for irradiance [mol C (mol photons)^{-1}] (computed)
  Y_{E}: Carbon yield on light energy [mol C (mol photons)^{-1}] (parameter)
  k_{ye}: Coefficient controlling the light-dependent change in carbon yield (parameter)
  q_{nl}: Rate portion of carbon redirection from carbohydrate to lipid accumulation [unitless] (computed)
  \phi: Coefficient setting the carbon-redirection portion in the neutral-lipid law [-] (parameter)
  k_{N}: Coefficient controlling the nitrate-dependent response in the error-function law [m^{3} (mol N)^{-1}] (parameter)
  S_{NO3}: Concentration of nitrate as N in the reactor [mol N m^{-3}] (computed)
  m_{chl}: Chl-a degradation rate [time^-1] (computed)
  m: Functional biomass degradation rate [time^-1] (parameter)
  k_{I}: Light-response coefficient in the Chl-a degradation expression (parameter)

Model-wide assumptions (already recorded, do not repeat):
  - Optical cross‑section parameters a and b are taken as constant regardless of cultivation conditions.
  - The composition of functional biomass is fixed to CH1.8O0.5N0.2.
  - Nitrate uptake is assumed to equal the nitrate removed from the medium.
